fetch_image_from_path: fetch an image from a local file path and return a PIL Image object
fetch_image_from_url: fetch an image from an http or https url and return a PIL Image object
extract_data_dir_directory: extract and return a directory path when the input is a valid directory
extract_data_dir_key_value: parse a comma-separated key=value string into a dictionary for image, video, or audio keys
review_visual_keys: review the VISUAL_KEYS list containing multimodal model component names like vision_tower and multimodal_projector
